heard: NASA fired backup thrusters on a probe in interstellar space. These backup engines had stayed completely silent since 1980. Voyager 1 was drifting over 11 billion miles from home. These components stayed cold and unused in the void. Its primary steering jets were finally starting to fail. Engineers sent a signal during late 2017 to wake the backups. Those 37-year-old thrusters fired perfectly on the first try. The ancient probe can now keep calling home for years. we still depend on backup thrusters in interstellar space.
